name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI research assistant that reads what real people are saying across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News and more on a topic, then writes a grounded, sourced summary.
buyer: A PR consultant, solo marketer, or sales rep who needs a fast 'what's the internet saying about X' brief before a launch or a call.
business_use_cases: A PR or communications freelancer sells 'social sentiment briefings' to clients ahead of a product launch instead of running a manual research sprint.
A sales rep generates a one-page 'what this prospect's company and industry is buzzing about' brief before every sales call.
A newsletter writer builds a paid weekly digest in a niche, using this tool as the research engine behind every issue.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid briefing report, billed per request.
Launch a niche subscriber newsletter powered by the weekly research output.

steal_this: Pick one niche, run this weekly, and launch a $10/month subscriber digest this weekend.
